# CampusHub Copilot Instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the shared repository rules for backend
layering, the `client/` frontend exception, TypeScript safety, and validation.

Use [.cursorignore](../.cursorignore) to exclude generated and historical content
from context searches; with ripgrep, pass `--ignore-file .cursorignore` explicitly.
Start backend queries in `src/` and expand only as the task requires.
